item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows two setups Aditya builds with the same thin steel wire. Setup M uses one cell. Setup N uses two cells in series. He closes each switch for 3 minutes. He also thinks about heat from a room heater and heat at a loose wall plug.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: The wire in N heats more than in M; that heating can be useful in a room heater but harmful at a loose wall plug.
options.B: The wire in M heats more than in N because one cell always produces more heat than two.
options.C: N heats more than M for any connection time, even if the switches are closed for unequal times.
options.D: Neither wire generates heat because neither wire glows.
